Right — the show is public by definition. So "small and quiet" was never really about the size of the piece. It was about you not having to stand next to it.

Which is the actual thing you can control. The piece can be in the show and you can still not be the one explaining it. No artist statement, no hovering by it, no watching Doretha's face while she looks.

Is that the quiet you're after — the piece goes up and you're not on duty?
